## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -15.21%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling shows complacency while HYG/LQD ratio ↓ falling signals rising credit stress, and SPY (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.32%) CORRECTION underscores mixed positioning.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -15.21%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress signal: HYG/LQD ↓ falling (credit stress rising) despite HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND. Gold accumulation: GLD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND → flat; TLT (1W: +1.49% | 1M: -0.43%) RECOVERY ↑ rising while Yield Curve (1W: +1.13%) ↑ rising shows modest steepening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals showing pockets of strength: XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +5.85%) ABOVE TREND and Materials breadth positive; Tech under pressure with XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) ↓ falling. Style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US in correction: SPY (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.32%) CORRECTION. China pockets of strength: FXI (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND while EM aggregate (EEM 1W: -1.80% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION — regional dispersion rising.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation heating: IBIT (1W: +22.57% | 1M: +22.81%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +16.73%) ABOVE TREND; small caps IWM (1W: -2.00% | 1M: +2.34%) CORRECTION, so risk-seeking is concentrated.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: GLD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +18.27%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +4.49%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy generally constructive: XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +5.85%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +3.26% | 1M: -3.79%) RECOVERY but volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED breadth: 7/11 sectors positive supports risk on at the margin; CONFIRMATION conflict — major divergence across core ETFs (SPY CORRECTION, XLK CORRECTION, TLT RECOVERY) → MAJOR Divergence that suppresses a clean regime tilt.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to gold/precious metals GLD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND and selective cyclicals XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +5.85%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to tech XLK (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) CORRECTION and defensives like XLU (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND while monitoring TLT (1W: +1.49% | 1M: -0.43%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +5.85%) ABOVE TREND if breadth holds ≥7/11. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) CORRECTION if 1W selling extends.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND on safe-haven flows. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +4.49%) CORRECTION if industrial cues deteriorate.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD 0.75 (credit stress pivot); SPY/TLT ~9.25 (risk vs duration); GLD momentum confirmation at sustained above-trend weekly performance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, but credit-stress signals and core ETF divergences make the market mixed. Precious metals and selective cyclicals showing strength while tech weakness and SPY/XLK/TLT mismatch are the key risks to monitor.
